Let's try possible h.

h=1: H=1, F=2. Then C<1 impossible. So h>=2.

h=2: H=2, F=3. C<2 => C=1. G<2 => G=1? But C=1, so G cannot be 1. G<2 means G=1 only, conflict. So h≠2.

h=3: H=3, F=4. C<3 => C=1 or 2. G<3 => G=1 or 2. C and G distinct, both <3. |C-G|>=3 impossible since max diff 1. So h≠3.

h=4: H=4, F=5. C<4 => C=1,2,3. G<4 => G=1,2,3. Need |C-G|>=3. Possible pairs: (1,4) no 4; (1,5) no; (1,? ) diff>=3: C=1,G=4 no; C=1,G=5 no; C=1,G=6 no. Within 1-3, max diff 2. So impossible. h≠4.

h=5: H=5, F=6. C<5 => C=1..4. G<5 => G=1..4. Need |C-G|>=3. Possible: (1,4) diff3, (4,1) diff3. Also (1,5) no. So C,G are {1,4} in some order. But C<A and G<H=5 ok. Also C<F=6 ok.

So h=5: H=5, F=6. C,G = {1,4}.

Check 8: |A-F|=2 => |A-6|=2 => A=4 or 8. But A must be > C (C<A). If C=4, then A>4 => A=8 possible. If C=1, A=4 or 8.

Also 6: |A-D|>=3. 14: |D-5|>=3 => D<=2 or D>=8.

Let's branch.

Case h=5, C=1, G=4. Then C<A => A>1. A=4 or 8. But G=4, so A cannot be 4 (slot taken). So A=8. Then F=6, H=5, C=1, G=4, A=8.

Check 6: |A-D|=|8-D|>=3 => D<=5 or D>=11. D<=5. But 14: |D-5|>=3 => D<=2 or D>=8. Intersection: D<=2. Also 13: B<D. So D must be 2? If D=2, B<2 => B=1. But C=1, conflict. If D=1, B<1 impossible. So D<=2 fails because B<D and C=1 occupies 1. D=2 => B=1 conflict. D=1 impossible. So C=1,G=4 fails.

Case h=5, C=4, G=1. Then C<A => A>4. A=4 or 8 from |A-6|=2. A=4 not >4, so A=8. So A=8, F=6, H=5, C=4, G=1.

Check 6: |8-D|>=3 => D<=5 or D>=11 => D<=5.
14: |D-5|>=3 => D<=2 or D>=8. Intersection: D<=2.
13: B<D. D<=2. If D=2, B<2 => B=1. But G=1, conflict. If D=1, B<1 impossible. So fails.

Thus h=5 impossible.

h=6: H=6, F=7. C<6 => C=1..5. G<6 => G=1..5. Need |C-G|>=3. Possible pairs within 1..5 diff>=3: (1,4),(1,5),(2,5),(4,1),(5,1),(5,2). Also C<A, G<6.

8: |A-7|=2 => A=5 or 9.

14: |D-6|>=3 => D<=3 or D>=9.

6: |A-D|>=3.

Let's branch on A.

A=5: Then C<5 => C=1..4. G<6 => G=1..5. Need |C-G|>=3. Also A=5, F=7, H=6.

D: from 14 D<=3 or D>=9. From 6: |5-D|>=3 => D<=2 or D>=8. Intersection: D<=2 or D>=9. Also 13: B<D.

If D<=2: D=1 or 2. B<D. If D=2, B=1. If D=1, B<1 impossible. So D=2, B=1.

Then C<5, G<6, C,G distinct from B=1,D=2,A=5,F=7,H=6. Remaining slots for C,G,E,I: 3,4,8,9? Wait slots: 1=B,2=D,5=A,6=H,7=F. Remaining: 3,4,8,9 for C,G,E,I. But C<5 => C=3 or 4. G<6 => G=3 or 4. Need |C-G|>=3 impossible since both in {3,4}. So D=2 fails.

If D>=9: D=9. Then B<9, B<G, B<E. Also 6: |5-9|=4 ok. 14: |9-6|=3 ok. 17: |C-9|>=3 => C<=6 or C>=12 => C<=6 (true since C<5). 7: |9-G|>=3 => G<=6 (true G<6). 4: |9-E|>=3 => E<=6.

Now slots: A=5, H=6, F=7, D=9. Remaining: 1,2,3,4,8 for B,C,G,E,I. C<5 => C=1,2,3,4. G<6 => G=1,2,3,4. Need |C-G|>=3. Possible: (1,4),(4,1). Also B<G, B<D=9 ok, B<E, B<G.

Also E<=6 from |9-E|>=3 => E<=6. E in remaining slots 1,2,3,4,8? E<=6 so E in 1,2,3,4. I is remaining.

Let's try C,G = (1,4) or (4,1).

Subcase C=1, G=4. Then B<G=4 => B=2 or 3 (since 1 taken). B<E. E<=6, E in remaining slots {2,3,8?} but E<=6 so E in {2,3}. I in remaining.

Slots used: C=1, G=4, A=5, H=6, F=7, D=9. Remaining: 2,3,8 for B,E,I. B<G=4 => B=2 or 3. B<E. E<=6 => E=2 or 3. I=8.

If B=2, E=3 works (B<E). Then I=8. Check 2: |E-I|=|3-8|=5>=3 ok. Check 9: |B-F|=|2-7|=5>=3 ok. Check 12: B<E 2<3 ok. Check 15: B<G 2<4 ok. Check 13: B<D 2<9 ok. Check 4: |D-E|=|9-3|=6>=3 ok. Check 7: |D-G|=|9-4|=5>=3 ok. Check 17: |C-D|=|1-9|=8>=3 ok. Check 3: |C-G|=|1-4|=3 ok. Check 6: |A-D|=|5-9|=4 ok. Check 14: |D-H|=|9-6|=3 ok. Check 8: |A-F|=|5-7|=2 ok. Check 1: H=6,F=7 ok. Check 5: C=1<H=6 ok. Check 10: G=4<H=6 ok. Check 11: C=1<A=5 ok. Check 16: C=1<F=7 ok. All constraints satisfied!
